subject: [PATCH v8 7/7] mm/memcontrol: restrict memory stock to leaf cgroups on v2

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch restricts memory stock to leaf cgroups in the new page_counter_stock world, ensuring that stock does not get stranded in the hierarchy and cannot be used by processes that actually charge. It achieves this by preventing stock from accumulating in non-leaf page_counters through three methods: clearing the parent's memory stock pointer, scheduling drains for non-isolated CPUs, and lazily cleaning up CPUs that are not drained due to isolation or racing with a refill. The patch also re-enables stock when a parent becomes a leaf again.
